G3_faithfulness.justification: The odd-sum constraint for values 1 and 2 is exactly the original no-shared-shift condition, and minimizing the powers-of-two penalty is exactly lexicographic minimization of the assignment.

G4_naturalness.justification: The financial narrative is coherent and readable, though its elaborate terminology and artificial penalty model make it somewhat less natural than the original formulation.
